meta_title: TVM Calculator: N, I/Y, PV, PMT and FV Solver
meta_description: A time value of money calculator laid out like a financial calculator: enter four of N, I/Y, PV, PMT and FV, set P/Y, C/Y and BGN or END, and compute the fifth.
subtitle: Compute N, I/Y, PV, PMT or FV from the other four, with payments and compounding per year and BGN or END timing, just like a financial calculator.

card.fields_html:
Time value of money keys

Compute (CPT)

Pick the key to compute. Its box shows the answer; enter the other four.

Sign convention: cash flowing out (a deposit, a payment) is negative; cash flowing in (a loan received, a withdrawal) is positive. A loan has PV positive and PMT negative; savings have PV and PMT negative and FV positive. PV, PMT and FV can't all have the same sign.
